author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical - WP Duplicate Unauth Arbitrary File Upload to RCE (CVE-2026-123751). WP Duplicate plugin <= 1.1.11 improperly verifies a request auth value and fails to validate upload path/type, letting unauthenticated attackers write arbitrary files (e.g., PHP webshell).

author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-116779 in FreeSWITCH is a critical RCE (CVSS 9.8) that's actively exploited, despite a low EPSS (1%). Prioritize patching: confirmed exploitation always trumps predictive scores.

author: saadaltaflaldin
text: Ethereum Swarm, a decentralized storage network, got hit with a supply chain attack: hackers took over its release process and pushed two poisoned updates, bee-js 13.3.0 on npm and Swarm Desktop 0.56.2.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: ARTEX, an AI-native autonomous penetration framework tied to Chinese Storm-0940, was observed attacking live AWS environments in October 2026, hunting for financial data, secrets, and cloud credentials through compromised IAM keys and public Cognito pools.

author: dailytechonx
text: Security alert: Hackers exploited the IAM role trust relationship between Qubole and AWS, using correct External IDs to breach customer accounts. Stolen data spans S3 buckets, Lambda env vars, Secrets Manager, SSM. If you’ve ever connected Qubole — audit CloudTrail logs since Oct https://t.co/Ewk1dB95je

text: CISA now lists OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158 (sshole) as actively exploited. On Linux hosts using musl, like Alpine, with PAM disabled, attackers can bypass password login. Update to OpenSSH 10.6p2.

text: Plex2Shell (CVE-2026-96652 chain) is actively exploited against QNAP NAS Plex instances for unauthenticated RCE. Audit port 32400 exposures, patch to 1.43.3+, and pull management behind a VPN.

text: CVE-2026-61511: critical unauthenticated RCE in vBulletin 5.x/6.x via runMaths eval injection. Nuclei detection template available.

author: CCBalert
text: Multiple critical vulnerabilities in IBM API Connect, including CVE-2026-17402 (CVSS 9.9), allowing authenticated RCE. Other flaws permit unauthenticated administrative takeover. Patch immediately!

author: DailyCVEBrief
text: DEEP DIVE: CVE-2026-19868 lets a password for a non-SAML login method skip SAML and its MFA on SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN (Gen7 and Gen8). Exploited in the wild, on CISA KEV since Nov 6. Fixed in 7.3.4-7013 and 8.2.3-8015. https://t.co/u5W0aaq8fR

author: cveintelligence
text: Critical 9.3 | CVE-2026-124079: rConfig Core – unauthenticated RCE by pushing a crafted serialized job onto the Laravel Horizon queue. Fixed in 8.2.19 (Core) / 8.4.1 (Pro).

author: saltrocklabs
text: An AI agent found exposed API endpoints, logged in with a dev credential left in prod, and pulled records with no rate limit (per WorkOS's write-up). Agents make old sloppiness cheap to exploit, fast.

author: DuckButTurttle
text: Operation Snowball: an AI-agent intrusion into a European telecom exploited Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320. Researchers say it reached a hospital records system on default credentials, but that part is unverified. Source: GBHackers
